logp.method_description: In 1-octanol and buffer liquid system, the lipid–water partition coefficients of all complexes were determined by standard flask method.54 In short, 2 mL 1-octanol containing 25 μg mL-1 ruthenium complexes and 2 mL PBS were mixed, then the samples were kept for 2 h after shaking the solution for 6 h at 37 °C. The absorbance of the complex at 286 nm in 1-octanol solution was measured before and after the oscillation. The partition coefficient is reported as the content of complexes in octanol divided by the content in water. Each experiment was repeated three times.
